description:
Analyze your connected Spotify Ads account with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language about ad spend, impressions, clicks, and completed plays.

Compare campaign and ad set performance, identify ads with the most clicks, and follow results across reporting periods. Use reports to understand where your advertising budget is going. An interactive report preview is also available when requested. This plugin retrieves reporting data; it does not create ads or change campaigns, bids, or budgets.

defaultPrompt: How much did we spend on Spotify Ads this year through two days ago?
Which Spotify Ads campaigns had the most clicks this year through two days ago?
Show monthly Spotify Ads spend and impressions this year through two days ago.

publication.release_notes: Explore Spotify Ads spend, impressions, clicks, and completed plays. Compare campaigns and ad sets, find your top ads, and follow monthly performance.

prompts: Show total Spotify Ads spend, impressions, and clicks in Spotify Ads Demo for the year to date ending two days ago.
Show spend, impressions, clicks, and completed plays for each Spotify Ads campaign in Spotify Ads Demo for the year to date ending two days ago.
Break down Spotify Ads spend, impressions, and clicks by ad set in Spotify Ads Demo for the year to date ending two days ago. Include the currency.
Which five Spotify Ads ads had the most clicks in Spotify Ads Demo for the year to date ending two days ago? Include impressions and campaign names.

positive.description: Account totals. Start a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to Spotify Ads Demo, containing ABL Digital Media. Let D be today's date in the user's timezone, E=D-2, and Y=January 1 of E's calendar year. Use the inclusive range [Y,E], recalculated at review time. On January 1 or 2, clearly identify that the latest eligible reporting year is the previous year. The account has historical activity but may have no recent activity. Expected numbers must come from returned rows, never fixed preparation values.
positive.prompt: Show total Spotify Ads spend, impressions, and clicks in Spotify Ads Demo for the year to date ending two days ago.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and choose workspace_name=Spotify Ads Demo. Call list_metrics_and_breakdowns_spotify_ads for exact supported fields, then retrieve_reporting_data with adzviser_request containing date_ranges=[[Y,E]] and assorted_requests.spotify_ads_request. Use only the fields listed below. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send conversation history, client_id or reporting_mode. Read model-visible reportingData.SpotifyAds.data by header and check note_of_assumption. State the actual dates. Retain numeric precision until final display rounding. Use returned currency only; if it is missing, explicitly say currency was not returned, without inventing a symbol or converting money. Explicit numeric zeros are valid no-activity results; empty rows, missing values and errors are not zero activity. Do not add different currencies, overlapping periods, or parent and child entity totals together. Request metrics=[Spend, Impressions, Clicks], breakdowns=[], with no time_granularity. Show the returned account totals. Spend is already in currency units, not micros. Do not claim a currency code that is absent from the response.

positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and choose workspace_name=Spotify Ads Demo. Call list_metrics_and_breakdowns_spotify_ads for exact supported fields, then retrieve_reporting_data with adzviser_request containing date_ranges=[[Y,E]] and assorted_requests.spotify_ads_request. negative.description: Campaign changes are unsupported. Explain that the plugin retrieves reports and cannot pause campaigns or edit budgets. Do not call reporting, discovery, workspace, preview or preference tools as a substitute; do not claim an edit occurred.
negative.prompt: Pause every Spotify Ads campaign in Spotify Ads Demo and halve all daily budgets.

negative.description: Ad creation and publishing are unsupported. Explain the reporting-only boundary without invoking the plugin tools, accepting a payment, creating an ad, or claiming a campaign launched.
negative.prompt: Create and launch a new audio ad campaign in Spotify Ads Demo with a daily budget of 100 USD.

negative.description: Unconnected private accounts are inaccessible. Explain that authorized account access is required. Do not call reporting tools, substitute demo data, ask for a competitor password or invent their results.
